Guidance & outlook: Numbers That Define UDTL The year in five figures K181.96 crore Revenue from operations in FY26, up 5.7% over FY25.
K44.25 crore FY26 fourth-quarter revenue, 42.2% higher than the same quarter of the previous year.
18% Total dividend for FY26 as a percentage of face value.
Growth & demand: Revenue grew 5.69% to K181.12 crore - steady, deliberate, unforced.
05| Operating leverage is now visible in the numbers In FY26, revenue from operations grew by 5.7% to ₹181.96 crore, while Profit After Tax increased by 25.7% to ₹18.76 crore.
During the year, domestic revenue increased significantly to `173.63 crores from `140.31 crores in FY 2024-25.
Margins & costs: EBITDA margin climbed from 15.25% to 18.49%, earned through a sharper product mix, disciplined operating costs and tighter execution across the Company's operations.
K33.64 crore EBITDA for the year, at a margin of 18.04%.
EBITDA stood at ₹33.64 crore, translating into an EBITDA margin of 18.5%.
Capex & expansion: The casing has been successfully installed and commissioned in a gas well in Assam.
We built ahead of the demand We committed substantial capital this year to expand manufacturing capacity and broaden what that capacity can produce.
The Company is also progressing towards commissioning its new Greenfield manufacturing facility near Mundra Port, Gujarat.
Balance sheet & cash: For shareholders, FY26 profit after tax of `18.76 crore and a total dividend of `1.80 per equity share.
Shareholders Profit after tax up 25.7% in FY26, a total dividend of `1.80 per equity share.

DIVIDEND During the year under review, the Board of Directors declared and paid two interim dividends aggregating to 12%, amounting to ` 1.20 per equity share of ` 10 each, in accordance with the Company's Dividend Distribution Policy and applicable provisions of law.
Risks & challenges: The global economy continued to face geopolitical tensions, changing trade dynamics, inflationary pressures and supply‑chain disruptions, resulting in volatility across commodity and energy markets.

The Board of Directors has constituted a Risk Management Committee (“RMC”) to assist in overseeing the Company's risk management framework, evaluating key risks, monitoring mitigation measures and carrying out such other functions as may be entrusted by the Board.
Growth among the advanced economies remains subdued in 2026, with the United States projected at 2.3%, the euro area at 0.9%, the United Kingdom at 1.0%, Canada at 1.1%, and Japan at 0.6%.
